events.observed_signal: Durable readiness evidence covered eighteen non-TikTok sources, but only four Tier-A sources had both reviewed executable method locks and immutable total campaign caps.

correction.action: Kept the complete durable inventory while marking every Tier-B/Tier-C source without an entered caveat and exact total cap preflight_skipped with zero provider access.

learning.reusable_lesson: Reviewed source evidence does not imply a live campaign cap or executable eligibility.
learning.future_prevention: Require a finite method lock, environment lock and total provider cap before adding any source to the active set.

events.observed_signal: Embedding an archive's final SHA-256 inside that same archive would change the archive and invalidate the claimed hash.

correction.action: Used an embedded campaign manifest for non-self members and a detached delivery manifest that pins every member including the embedded manifest plus the exact final ZIP size and SHA-256.

learning.reusable_lesson: Self-contained cryptographic self-hashes are circular; exact delivery integrity needs a detached final envelope.
learning.future_prevention: Specify embedded member-manifest and detached delivery-manifest roles explicitly for future archive contracts.

events.observed_signal: The Gourmet regression stopped before assertions because the standalone test process could not import the service control_plane package.

correction.action: Set PYTHONPATH to the service root for the deterministic test command and reran the interrupted regression set unchanged.

learning.reusable_lesson: Standalone tool tests require the service root on PYTHONPATH when they import sibling packages.
learning.future_prevention: Use the CI-equivalent service-root PYTHONPATH for all exact-corpus commands.

events.observed_signal: Existing Big C and Makro operational functions could enter a headless rendered fallback even though the Tier-A P59 method locks prohibit browser execution.

correction.action: Added an explicit browser_mode disabled input honored by the existing functions and made the P59 adapter always pass it while replacing render entry points with fail-closed diagnostics.

learning.reusable_lesson: An existing technique can contain a broader fallback than a later campaign method lock permits.
learning.future_prevention: Make execution-mode prohibitions explicit adapter inputs and test that fallback entry points remain unreachable.

events.observed_signal: Existing progressive source functions derived their frontier from the operations database, which P59 must not write, so repeated visits could replay the same frontier.

correction.action: Added optional deterministic page, product, and SKU offsets supplied by the isolated campaign ledger without changing default behavior.

learning.reusable_lesson: An isolated one-time runner needs an explicit frontier independent of production operations state.
learning.future_prevention: Expose deterministic optional offsets while preserving source technique defaults and cross-round identity deduplication.

events.observed_signal: The first manifest draft referenced representative Shopee, Lazada, Coffee and YouTube fixtures rather than every available source fixture.

correction.action: Expanded the immutable fixture lists to every available relevant fixture file and added per-source zero-provider replay assertions.

learning.reusable_lesson: Representative fixtures are insufficient when a closure contract says every available fixture.
learning.future_prevention: Persist the full fixture inventory and assert a per-source replay disposition before live execution.

events.observed_signal: The sealed canary correctly stopped Tops on HTTP 403, but the first execute path initialized a fresh ledger that would have retried the terminal source and omitted four canary operations from campaign totals.

correction.action: Required execute mode to import one exact sealed canary ledger, count all four prior operations, preserve Tops as terminal, and use a sanitized hash attestation without rewriting the original evidence.

learning.reusable_lesson: A pre-live canary is part of the campaign safety ledger, not a disposable connectivity check.
learning.future_prevention: Require sealed canary import and budget reconciliation before the first campaign operation, preserving all access stops as terminal.
